Title: Invalid login with wrong password
Steps: 1. Open Sign in 2. Enter valid email and incorrect password 3. Click Login
ExpectedResult: Login error message is displayed and user remains on login page unauthenticated

Title: Product search returns matching results
Steps: 1. Locate search input 2. Enter existing product name 3. Submit search 4. Review results list
ExpectedResult: Search results display at least one matching product with correct name

Title: Add multiple different products to cart
Steps: 1. Login 2. Open first product and click Add to cart 3. Return to home 4. Open second product and click Add to cart 5. Open cart
TestData: User: customer2@practicesoftwaretesting.com | Products: any two in-stock items
ExpectedResult: Cart shows two distinct line items with correct product names

Title: Update product quantity in cart
Preconditions: User logged in with one product in cart
Steps: 1. Login 2. Add one product to cart 3. Open cart 4. Change quantity to 3 5. Save or refresh cart totals
ExpectedResult: Cart quantity updates to 3 and line total reflects quantity change

Title: Cash on Delivery checkout with double confirm
Preconditions: User logged in with items in cart
Steps: 1. Login 2. Add product to cart 3. Proceed to checkout 4. Fill billing address 5. Select Cash on Delivery 6. Click Confirm twice
TestData: Billing: Zoey Shore Hesselbury Florida United States 1234AA | Payment: cash-on-delivery
ExpectedResult: Payment success message appears and order completion message is shown

Title: Verify invoice appears under My Invoices
Steps: 1. Open profile menu 2. Click My Invoices 3. Locate latest invoice
ExpectedResult: Invoice list shows new invoice with visible invoice number

Title: Checkout blocked with missing billing fields
Preconditions: User logged in with items in cart
Steps: 1. Login 2. Add product to cart 3. Proceed to checkout 4. Leave required billing fields empty 5. Attempt to continue
ExpectedResult: Validation errors are shown and user cannot complete checkout
